neighbours.label: Preposition completing a verb of informing a website's owners ('provide us with', 'tell us about'): the request for the reader's input
fire: If you spot a problem on this page, please provide us with the details so we can fix it.
If something on our website looks wrong, tell us about it using the form below.
If you have a question about your order, please contact us with your reference number.
Thanks for visiting; please share with us any ideas for improving this site.
If you found a broken link on this page, let us know about it by email.
If you were unhappy at the end of your visit, please write to us about what went wrong.
We would love to hear from you if you have feedback on these pages.
Please supply us with your order number so we can look into it.
quiet: If you spot a problem on this page, please fill in the form so we can fix it.
If something on our website looks wrong, use the form below right away.
If you have a problem, please call before noon today.
Thanks for visiting; please come back soon and bring a friend to this site.
If you found a broken link on this page, just reload it and try again.
If you were unhappy at the end of your visit, please accept this voucher and our apologies.
We would love to see you again if you are ever back in these parts.
Please keep your order number safe so you can look it up later.

notes: Needs long sentences with the page context: short probes of the same phrase scored near 0. The card's other prepositions (' for', ' of') are not covered.
